identity.lore: An abandoned celestial courthouse where mortals once petitioned absent gods. Its empty seats and eclipsed judgment oculus now frame sanctioned duels over who has the right to judge divine power.
identity.narrativePurpose: Establish the NGA thesis that gods can be judged while remaining faction-neutral and competitively legible enough to become a foundational arena.
identity.timeOfDay: Eclipse dusk at the last edge of daylight

composition.foreground: Sparse broken brass rail fragments and stone edge markers outside the gameplay-safe center; no moving foreground form may cross a fighter silhouette.
composition.midground: A flat tribunal dais, restrained columns, and empty witness balconies with broad value blocks and deliberately reduced detail behind the combat lane.
composition.background: A deep ruined nave, distant city silhouettes, and a central eclipsed judgment oculus placed above normal fighter and jump silhouettes.
composition.gameplayFloor: Perfectly flat matte basalt with a low-contrast aged-brass judgment circle and boundary inlays; no slope, mirror reflection, raised seam, or rendered height may imply gameplay collision.
composition.stageSilhouette: A central eclipse and apse framed by tall side columns beyond the walls, with a low-frequency open center and unmistakable boundary pylons at both corners.

readability.contrastZonesBehindFighters: Maintain a dark neutral low-detail mask from world X -8.2 to 8.2 and Y 0.35 to 5.8; suppress local saturation and highlights behind the torso and head bands.
readability.vfxVisibilityZones: Reserve a neutral beam corridor across X -9.2 to 9.2, Y 0.4 to 4.8; keep the projectile lane Y 0.45 to 3.8 and a 2.2-unit hit-spark radius around each fighter root free of competing emission.
readability.jumpHeight: The oculus rim begins above world Y 6.1 and atmospheric detail is softened through the approved root-height range 0 to 3.6 so airborne silhouettes remain separated.
readability.corners: Each wall is marked by a dark brass pylon centered at world X -8.4 or 8.4, with a calm ash-value backing panel and no animated banner, lamp, or bright window behind the trapped fighter.

cameraRequirements.commandGrab: Use close_combat volume for 32 ticks, preserve both roots plus 0.8 world-unit margin, keep the floor contact region visible, and return through the approved 12-tick gameplay blend.
cameraRequirements.super: Use wide_super volume for 42 ticks; show both fighters and the attack line, forbid occluding columns, and retain projectile or beam travel room when applicable.
cameraRequirements.ultimate: Use ultimate volume for 60 ticks with constrained lateral mirroring, both fighters present through impact, no free orbit, and an approved 12-tick return.
cameraRequirements.roundFinisher: Use finisher volume for 48 ticks only after the authoritative round result; retain winner, defeated fighter, floor contact, and the arena oculus without hiding the corner relationship.

permitted: slow banner drift outside the contrast mask
sparse dust motes outside the projectile and beam corridors
eclipse-corona luminance pulse capped at two percent
distant city silhouettes moving below fighter-readable frequency
deterministic environmental reaction markers emitted by the simulation presentation stream
ambientMotion.deterministicCapturePolicy: Freeze ambient timelines at the requested simulation tick or seed them from matchId plus arenaId; visual-regression and rollback captures must reproduce identical frames.

prohibitedVisualNoise: moving foreground occluders over the combat lane
high-frequency banners or masonry detail behind fighters
bright oculus or windows behind head and torso height
debris or particles crossing the combat lane
camera shake originating from ambient stage motion
animated hazards or implied gameplay hazards

productionContract.stageEdgeBehavior: Clamp the unordered fighter-pair midpoint to world X -7.8 through 7.8, preserve environment overscan beyond walls, and never move fighters or wall anchors to satisfy framing.

humanDecisions: Approve or rename The Last Tribunal and its celestial-courthouse lore.
Approve eclipse dusk as the time-of-day lock.
Approve ink blue-black, cathedral red, aged brass, ash gray, and cool violet as the palette family.
Choose how prominent the eclipsed judgment oculus may be without competing with fighters.
Approve the flat basalt and brass gameplay-floor motif.
Approve the one-primary-light plus ambient-fill lighting model.
Approve the draw-call, triangle, texture-memory, and dynamic-light budgets.
Approve the five cinematic safe volumes and event durations.
Approve ambient banners, dust, corona pulse, and distant silhouettes as the permitted motion set.
Authorize concept art and blockout production while keeping final art, runtime integration, and deployment gated.
